description: HOLLAND, MI — It’s the 15th of the month, which means it’s payday across Southwest Michigan. But Michiganders wondering why their paychecks are shrinking have Tax Man Sean McCann to thank for it. While we’re struggling to get by, Sean McCann’s treated hardworking families as his personal ATM. Here’s how: “Every payday, Michigan families are doing the math and realizing Sean…
